title: The Capabilities of Laser Scanning in Estimating the Leaf Area Index (LAI) and the Underlying Surface for Mapping the Microclimate of an Urban Park
content: In this paper discussed capabilities of combining the results of mobile ground-based lidar with microclimatic observations to rapidly create heat maps in the park of the Far Eastern Federal University (FEFU) campus. Illustrated that deep processing of point clouds makes it possible to obtain information about type of underlying surface, shading, orientation, relief, leaf area index (LAI). Based on information obtained, using the examples of hot days in 2025 and 2026 years, a correlation analysis was conducted with microclimatic observations, which made it possible to determine the rates of heating/cooling of air and surface in the park. The authors propose an algorithm for constructing detailed maps of air and surface temperature under conditions of limited microclimatic observations, using results of mobile ground-based lidar of urban parks for hot days.
